content.title: Should investors be buying Beyond Meat's meme stock rally?
content.description:
Plant-based meat alternatives company Beyond Meat (BYND) is seeing its stock catapult by 1,300% over the last four trading sessions, breathing life into a new meme trading frenzy in names like Krispy Kreme (DNUT) and 1-800-Flowers.com (FLWS).

B. Riley Wealth Chief Market Strategist Art Hogan and Yahoo Finance senior reporter Ines Ferré discuss the drivers in this current meme stock craze and investor sentiment, going so far as to call meme trends "casino stocks."

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Opening Bid.
